profile.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm Izzy, a fullstack software engineer currently working at Academia.edu. 

Experienced in developing web applications using a Ruby and JavaScript techstack of Ruby on Rails backend with React frontend, PostgreSQL database, and deploying through AWS EC2. Familiar working in agile remote environments, with a strong aptitude for autonomy. 

Previously a forensic toxicologist. What drew me into software engineering is how it blends logic and creativity. Ever since I've admired the industry's constant drive towards improvement and innovation.

Technical Skills
Front-End | JavaScript, React, HTML5, CSS3, Webpack
Backend | Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL,  RESTful API Development
Test-Driven Development (TDD)
Developer Tools | Git, NPM, Bash, Agile Methodology, Scrum

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Fullstack engineer launching Academia.edu Journals, a suite of peer-reviewed, open access scientific publications.
- Frontend lead for the journal microsites

positions.title: Lead Software Engineering Immersive Resident
positions.description:
- Work 1:1 with students to develop their engineering skills and non-technical growth
- Serve as point person between other residents and management to surface any potential issues

positions.title: Software Engineering Immersive Resident
positions.description:
- Fostered the professional development of full-stack software engineers in training
- Mentored 100+ students on Javascript concepts and software engineering topics
- Provided technical assistance and shaped the critical problem-solving process of students

positions.title: Fullstack Developer
positions.description:
- Served as the product manager to develop the client’s proposed application to find, review, and save local coffee shops.
- Configured Facebook Developer API and Firebase to allow users to Sign In with Facebook.
- Created an endpoint in Next.js to dynamically generate unique pages using a Google Places id and render third-party and internal database content.
- Implemented a visit tracking feature to allow users to save coffee shops they’re interested in and have been to.
- Tech stack: React, Next.js, Vercel, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Firebase,

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
- Worked in an agile team of three to transform a growing e-commerce app to reliably handle 120k requests per minute.
- Replaced a monolithic legacy API with a highly scalable service-oriented RESTful API. 
- ETLed 10 million rows of raw data and read-optimized the database for average query times of 12ms.
- Ensured consistent service up to 1500 RPS with average response times of 70ms and 0.00% error rate using Nginx load balancing and caching to scale horizontally.
- Tech stack: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, AWS, K6, New Relic, Loader.IO, Nginx

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Modernized an e-commerce platform, strictly adhering to wireframes and a 27-page business requirements document.
- Using pure CSS and React, created a set of carousels for the main image gallery with thumbnail views and implemented functionality that follows the user’s cursor to selectively zoom in on the main image.
- Decreased page load times via compression and minification from 5s to 1.2s
- Implemented social media sharing using Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest APIs to increase marketing reach.
- Tech stack: React, Node.js, Express, Webpack, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Senior Criminalist
positions.description:
- Continued all Criminalist duties while being responsible for training employees and leading multiple service teams.
- Performed regular reviews of drug services and prepared quarterly reports of quality control data. 
Conducted research, development, and validation on scientific methods to improve the confirmation and quantification of drugs in biological specimens using instruments such as GCMS. 
- Did administrative and technical review of analyst reports on a weekly basis.

positions.title: Criminalist
positions.description:
- Performed over 10,000 independent toxicological analyses on post-mortem biological specimens, using instruments such as GC/MS to confirm and quantitate drugs and toxic substances following ANAB and ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation guidelines.
- Provided independent analysis, interpretation, and documentation of laboratory results and forensic testing. 
- Performed forensic investigations at crime scenes by examining, collecting, documenting, interpreting, and preserving physical evidence, operating investigative equipment, and maintaining a proper chain of custody.
- Designed report templates to improve readability and created database queries to generate annual reports.
